name: io.github.jyswee/a2a-trustgate
description: A2A TrustGate: 4-gate firewall that screens every AI-agent action before it runs. 49 tools.

environmentVariables.name: A2A_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: A2A TrustGate API key (a2a_...). Optional: without a key the server starts and can guide signup; most tools require a key to call the firewall.

environmentVariables.name: A2A_URL
environmentVariables.description: Base URL of the A2A TrustGate API. Defaults to https://a2ainfrastructure.com.

headers.name: Authorization
headers.description: Bearer token using your A2A TrustGate API key: 'Bearer a2a_...'. Optional — connect keyless to start in onboarding mode and self-provision a tenant in-session.
